feed.title: Ripple / 涟漪
feed.subtitle: Guides and comparisons from the developer of Ripple, a free app blocker for Android and iPhone, for adults and for parents.

entry.title: Ripple vs FocusMe and BlockerX: strict app blockers compared
entry.summary: FocusMe has strict plans and computer sync, BlockerX filters adult content and tells a partner about uninstalls, Ripple sets free per app limits on Android with an unlock code. For adults who keep turning their blocker off and for parents.

entry.title: 涟漪和 FocusMe、BlockerX 怎么选：难以绕过的 App 限制对比
entry.summary: FocusMe 计划可以设得很严还能和电脑同步，BlockerX 过滤成人内容并在卸载时通知伙伴，涟漪在安卓上免费按 App 设限制，用解锁码管住放松。写给总关掉限制的大人，也写给家长。

entry.title: Ripple vs Flipd and SPACE: study timer, habit tracker or app blocker
entry.summary: Flipd times study sessions and locks apps while one runs, SPACE tracks screen time and unlocks. Ripple sets rules that stay on all day, for adults studying or working and for parents setting homework time on a child's phone.

entry.title: 涟漪和 Flipd、SPACE 怎么选：学习计时、习惯记录还是 App 限制
entry.summary: Flipd 计时期间锁 App，SPACE 记录屏幕时间和解锁次数，涟漪设整天有效的规则。写给考试季的大人，也写给给孩子设写作业时段的家长。

entry.title: Ripple vs Kidslox and FamiSafe
entry.summary: Paid parental control with remote management and monitoring, or a free app blocker with no account, for parents and for adults.

entry.title: 涟漪和 Kidslox、FamiSafe 怎么选
entry.summary: 带监控的付费家长控制，还是不用注册的免费 App 限制，写给家长和大人自己。

entry.title: Ripple vs Olauncher and minimalist phone
entry.summary: Minimalist launchers hide icons, an app blocker sets limits. What each does for adults and on a child's phone.

entry.title: Ripple vs YourHour and Regain
entry.summary: Floating timers, Reels blocking and Pro plans compared with a free Android app blocker with daily limits and an unlock code.
